finding: Gestational age, sex, distance from a previous pregnancy, maternal weight, type of delivery, number of abortions, and birth rank were all found to be correlated with birth weight.
mod_finding: Type of delivery had both direct and indirect effects on birth weight, mediated by gestational age.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: girls (3200 ± 421) g, boys (3310 ± 444) g
